table.retrieve:
SELECT itemname = case printable when  0  then ltrim(str(item.icode)) + ' Counter Sale'   else item.name end,
			itemcounter=1, 
			reprintdate=getdate(),
			users.username,  
			accounts.name, 
			headerno =max(saleledgermodified.headerno),
			dbo.saleledgermodified.saleinvcode,   
         date =dbo.saleledgermodified.date,
         invdiscperc = dbo.saleledgermodified.discperc,   
         misccharges = dbo.saleledgermodified.misccharges,   
         invflatdisc = dbo.saleledgermodified.flatdisc,   
         salestax = dbo.saleledgermodified.salestax,   
         dbo.saleledgermodified.custcode,   
         remarks = dbo.saleledgermodified.remarks,
   		custrefno = dbo.saleledgermodified.custrefno,	
         icode = dbo.saledetailmodified.icode,   
         gcode = dbo.saledetailmodified.gcode,
         max(saleledgermodified.salecatcode),
			Id        = MAX(dbo.saledetailmodified.IDENTITYCOL),     
         looseqty  = sum(saledetailmodified.looseqty), 
			packqty   = sum(saledetailmodified.packqty), 
			packunits = max(saledetailmodified.packunits), 
	 		saleprice = max(saledetailmodified.saleprice), 
	 		rate      = max(saledetailmodified.rate),
         salestax  = max(saledetailmodified.salestax),   
         discperc  = max(saledetailmodified.discperc), 
			customername='                                  '  ,
         itemflatdisc  = max(saledetailmodified.itemflatdisc),
			unitsalestax  = max(saledetailmodified.unitsalestax),
			gstperc       = max(saledetailmodified.gstperc),
			invgstperc    = max(saleledgermodified.invgstperc1),
			reprintcounter=max(saleledgermodified.reprintingcounter),
			patient=(select patient.name from patient where patient.patientcode=:ra_patientCode),
			patientreg=(select patient.regno from patient where patient.patientcode=:ra_patientCode),
			doctor=(select doctors.name from doctors where doctors.doctcode=max(saleledgermodified.doctcode)),
			disease=(select name from disease where disease.DiseaseCode=max(saleledgermodified.DiseaseCode)),
			invtotal=(SELECT 
							netamount= Case when Round(Sum ( (  SD.looseqty * (  SD.saleprice -   SD.itemflatdisc)) *  (1 -   SD.discperc /100) * (1 -   SL.discperc /100) - flatdisc   +   misccharges), 2) IS NULL Then 0  Else Round(Sum ( (  SD.looseqty * (  SD.saleprice -   SD.itemflatdisc)) *  (1 -   SD.discperc /100) * (1 -   SL.discperc /100) ) - flatdisc   +   misccharges, 0) End 
										+
										Round(Sum (Round (  (SD.looseqty + SD.bonusqty)*   SD.unitsalestax + Round ( Round (  SD.looseqty * (  SD.saleprice -   SD.itemflatdisc ) * (1 -   SD.discperc * 0.01 ), 2 ) *   SD.gstperc * 0.01 , 2 ) , 2 ) )
							 			+  (Case when (Round(Sum ( (  SD.looseqty * (  SD.saleprice -   SD.itemflatdisc)) *  (1 -   SD.discperc /100) * (1 -   SL.discperc /100) - flatdisc), 2)) * SL.invgstperc1 * 0.01 IS NULL Then 0  Else (Round(Sum ( (  SD.looseqty * (  SD.saleprice -   SD.itemflatdisc)) *  (1 -   SD.discperc /100) * (1 -   SL.discperc /100) ) - flatdisc ,2) ) * SL.invgstperc1 * 0.01 End ), 0)
					    FROM saleledgermodified SL,
 								saledetailmodified SD
   					 WHERE (SL.saleinvcode=saleledgermodified.saleinvcode and
								 SL.saleinvcode = SD.saleinvcode )
						 GROUP BY 	 SL.saleinvcode,
		 								 SL.flatdisc,
		 								 SL.misccharges,
                 					 SL.discperc,
		 								 SL.invgstperc1
					  )
    FROM 
		dbo.saleledgermodified,   
		dbo.saledetailmodified,  
		item, 
		customer, 
		accounts,
		users 

   WHERE ( dbo.saleledgermodified.patientcode = :ra_patientCode ) AND
			( dbo.saleledgermodified.saleinvcode = dbo.saledetailmodified.saleinvcode ) AND 
			( dbo.saleledgermodified.custcode = dbo.customer.custcode ) AND 
			( dbo.customer.custcode = dbo.accounts.acccode ) AND 
			( dbo.saleledgermodified.salesmancode = dbo.users.usercode ) AND
			( saledetailmodified.icode = item.icode ) 

GROUP BY saleledgermodified.saleinvcode, 
         saleledgermodified.date, 
			/*saleledgermodified.headerno,*/
			saleledgermodified.custcode, 
			saleledgermodified.discperc, 
			saleledgermodified.flatdisc, 
			saleledgermodified.misccharges, 
			saleledgermodified.salestax, 
			saleledgermodified.remarks,
			saleledgermodified.custrefno, 
			saledetailmodified.icode, 
			saledetailmodified.rowgroup,
			saledetailmodified.gcode, 
			item.name,
			item.icode,
			item.printable, 
			accounts.name,
			dbo.users.username
ORDER BY saleledgermodified.saleinvcode,
			MAX(dbo.saledetailmodified.IDENTITYCOL)

objects.name: c_salestaxval
objects.expression: round( ( ( looseqty *  saleprice ) - looseqty * itemflatdisc )  *  ( 1 -  (  discperc  * .01 )  )    *  gstperc * 0.01, 2) +  Round(looseqty * unitsalestax ,2)

objects.name: c_sumitemleveltaxval
objects.expression: sum(round( c_amount  *  gstperc * 0.01, 2) +  Round(looseqty * unitsalestax ,2) for group 1)

objects.name: c_invsalestaxval
objects.expression: Round((Round(sum((round(c_amount,2) ) for group 1)  *  (1 - invdiscperc * 0.01),2) -  invflatdisc  )  *  invgstperc  * 0.01,2)

objects.name: c_nettotal
objects.expression: /*Round(Sum (  c_netamount for all ) -  saleledger_flatdisc  +  saleledger_misccharges  + saleledger_salestax , 0)*/ Round(Sum (  c_netamount for group 1 ) -  invflatdisc  +  misccharges  + salestax , 0)  + Round(sum(c_salestaxval for group 1 ) + Round((Round(sum((round(c_amount,2) ) for group 1)  *  (1 - invdiscperc * 0.01) , 2) -  invflatdisc  )  *  invgstperc  * 0.01,2),0)

objects.name: c_totaltax
objects.expression: Round(Round((Round(sum((round(c_amount,2) ) for all)  *  (1 - invdiscperc * 0.01) ,2) -  invflatdisc  )  *  invgstperc  * 0.01,2) + sum(c_salestaxval for all) , 0)
